en: And if you want to, I didn't have three times, I was kind of busy. Then we say, in my jana kappa this, in my jana kappa
zh: 如果你想說我沒有三次，我有點忙。那麼我們說，在我的 jana kappa 裡，在我的 jana kappa 裡
ja: もし三回なかったとか、少し忙しかったと言いたいなら、私のjana kappaの中でと言います。
local: And if you want to, I didn't have three times, I was kind of busy. Then we say, in my jana kappa this, in my jana kappa
ja_pron: moshi sankai nakatta toka, sukoshi isogashikatta to iitai nara, watashi no jana kappa no naka de to iimasu.
native: And if you want to, I didn't have three times, I was kind of busy. Then we say, in my jana kappa this, in my jana kappa

en: and lastly the word good is un-irregular. So you have to be careful. Good, we say ki-i-i.
zh: 最後，good 這個詞是不規則的，所以你要小心。good 我們說 ki-i-i。
ja: 最後に、goodという言葉は不規則です。だから注意が必要です。goodはki-i-iと言います。
local: and lastly the word good is un-irregular. So you have to be careful. Good, we say ki-i-i.
ja_pron: saigo ni, good to iu kotoba wa fukisoku desu. dakara chūi ga hitsuyō desu. good wa ki-i-i to iimasu.
native: and lastly the word good is un-irregular. So you have to be careful. Good, we say ki-i-i.

en: So like e-na means I like it or sounds good. It's a gi-i, isn't irregular.
zh: 像 e-na 意味著我喜歡它或聽起來不錯。它是 gi-i，不是不規則的。
ja: 例えばe-naは「好き」や「良さそう」という意味です。gi-iで、不規則ではありません。
local: So like e-na means I like it or sounds good. It's a gi-i, isn't irregular.
ja_pron: tatoeba e-na wa 'suki' ya 'yosasō' to iu imi desu. gi-i de, fukisoku de wa arimasen.
native: So like e-na means I like it or sounds good. It's a gi-i, isn't irregular.

en: So you're here on the same not good, it's not e-kinai but it becomes yokinai, yokinai and yokinai this.
zh: 所以這裡的「不好」不是 e-kinai，而是變成 yokinai，yokinai，yokinai。
ja: ここでの「良くない」はe-kinaiではなく、yokinai、yokinai、yokinaiになります。
local: So you're here on the same not good, it's not e-kinai but it becomes yokinai, yokinai and yokinai this.
ja_pron: koko de no 'yokunai' wa e-kinai de wa naku, yokinai, yokinai, yokinai ni narimasu.
native: So you're here on the same not good, it's not e-kinai but it becomes yokinai, yokinai and yokinai this.

en: Do you want to say it I am smart. We say my head is good.
zh: 你想說我很聰明嗎？我們說我的頭腦很好。
ja: 「私は賢い」と言いたいですか？私たちは「頭が良い」と言います。
local: Do you want to say it I am smart. We say my head is good.
ja_pron: 'Watashi wa kashikoi' to iitai desu ka? Watashitachi wa 'atama ga yoi' to iimasu.
native: Do you want to say it I am smart. We say my head is good.

en: And the word we had is a pama and we say a pama gi-i, to someone who has a pama gi-i that means someone is smart.
zh: 我們有個詞是 a pama，我們說 a pama gi-i，對有 a pama gi-i 的人表示他很聰明。
ja: そして単語a pamaがあります。a pama gi-iと言います。a pama gi-iを持つ人は賢いという意味です。
local: And the word we had is a pama and we say a pama gi-i, to someone who has a pama gi-i that means someone is smart.
ja_pron: soshite tango a pama ga arimasu. a pama gi-i to iimasu. a pama gi-i o motsu hito wa kashikoi to iu imi desu.
native: And the word we had is a pama and we say a pama gi-i, to someone who has a pama gi-i that means someone is smart.

en: And if you want to say someone is not smart, we say a pama gi-i, yokinai, a pama gi-i-i-i-i-i.
zh: 如果你想說某人不聰明，我們說 a pama gi-i, yokinai, a pama gi-i-i-i-i-i。
ja: もし誰かが賢くないと言いたいなら、a pama gi-i, yokinai, a pama gi-i-i-i-i-iと言います。
local: And if you want to say someone is not smart, we say a pama gi-i, yokinai, a pama gi-i-i-i-i-i.
ja_pron: moshi dareka ga kashikokunai to iitai nara, a pama gi-i, yokinai, a pama gi-i-i-i-i-i to iimasu.
native: And if you want to say someone is not smart, we say a pama gi-i, yokinai, a pama gi-i-i-i-i-i.

en: If you want to say what's good, then again we should be the wrapper, it's a yokata, yokata, yokata.
zh: 如果你想說什麼是好的，那麼我們應該說 yokata, yokata, yokata。
ja: 何が良かったかと言いたいなら、またyokata, yokata, yokataと言います。
local: If you want to say what's good, then again we should be the wrapper, it's a yokata, yokata, yokata.
ja_pron: nani ga yokatta ka to iitai nara, mata yokata, yokata, yokata to iimasu.
native: If you want to say what's good, then again we should be the wrapper, it's a yokata, yokata, yokata.

en: So the movie was good. Then you say a goa, yokata, a goa, yokata, but it's about losing good.
zh: 所以電影很好。然後你說 a goa, yokata, a goa, yokata，但這是關於失去好的。
ja: だから映画は良かった。そう言う時はa goa, yokata, a goa, yokataと言いますが、良さを失うことについてです。
local: So the movie was good. Then you say a goa, yokata, a goa, yokata, but it's about losing good.
ja_pron: dakara eiga wa yokatta. sō iu toki wa a goa, yokata, a goa, yokata to iimasu ga, yosa o ushinau koto ni tsuite desu.
native: So the movie was good. Then you say a goa, yokata, a goa, yokata, but it's about losing good.

en: Again, yokinai kappa this, yokinai kappa this.
zh: 再次，yokinai kappa，yokinai kappa。
ja: また、yokinai kappa、yokinai kappaです。
local: Again, yokinai kappa this, yokinai kappa this.
ja_pron: mata, yokinai kappa, yokinai kappa desu.
native: Again, yokinai kappa this, yokinai kappa this.

en: So yokinai kuma and then kappa, yokinai kappa this. There is also one more irregular,
zh: 所以 yokinai kuma 然後 kappa，yokinai kappa。還有一個不規則的，
ja: だからyokinai kuma、そしてkappa、yokinai kappaです。もう一つ不規則なものがあります。
local: So yokinai kuma and then kappa, yokinai kappa this. There is also one more irregular,
ja_pron: dakara yokinai kuma, soshite kappa, yokinai kappa desu. mō hitotsu fukisoku na mono ga arimasu.
native: So yokinai kuma and then kappa, yokinai kappa this. There is also one more irregular,

en: which is kakui, which is like good looking for men, cool.
zh: 那是 kakui，像是男性的帥氣，酷。
ja: それはkakuiで、男性のかっこよさ、クールのようなものです。
local: which is kakui, which is like good looking for men, cool.
ja_pron: sore wa kakui de, dansei no kakkoyosa, kūru no yō na mono desu.
native: which is kakui, which is like good looking for men, cool.

en: It's not like let's go through the movie, more or better, cool.
zh: 這不是像「讓我們看電影」、「更多」或「更好」、「酷」那樣的用法。
ja: これは「映画を見よう」とか「もっと良い」とか「クール」という意味ではありません。
local: It's not like let's go through the movie, more or better, cool.
ja_pron: kore wa 'eiga o miyō' toka 'motto yoi' toka 'kūru' to iu imi de wa arimasen.
native: It's not like let's go through the movie, more or better, cool.

en: You can't use like that. It's literally good looking or cool because something is monday.
zh: 你不能那樣用。它字面意思是帥氣或酷，因為某事是星期一。
ja: そのようには使えません。文字通り「かっこいい」や「クール」という意味で、何かが月曜日だからです。
local: You can't use like that. It's literally good looking or cool because something is monday.
ja_pron: sono yō ni wa tsukaemasen. mojidoori 'kakkoii' ya 'kūru' to iu imi de, nanika ga getsuyōbi dakara desu.
native: You can't use like that. It's literally good looking or cool because something is monday.

en: The key one is a Mickey Mouse is handsome or Mickey Mouse is good looking cool.
zh: 關鍵是米奇老鼠很帥或米奇老鼠很酷。
ja: 重要なのはミッキーマウスがハンサム、またはミッキーマウスがかっこいいということです。
local: The key one is a Mickey Mouse is handsome or Mickey Mouse is good looking cool.
ja_pron: jūyō na no wa Mikkī Mausu ga hansamu, mata wa Mikkī Mausu ga kakkoii to iu koto desu.
native: The key one is a Mickey Mouse is handsome or Mickey Mouse is good looking cool.

en: Then you can say Mickey Mouse or kakui. But here's a he's not cool,
zh: 然後你可以說米奇老鼠很帥。但這裡他不酷，
ja: それからミッキーマウスはkakuiと言えます。でもここでは彼はかっこよくありません、
local: Then you can say Mickey Mouse or kakui. But here's a he's not cool,
ja_pron: sorekara Mikkī Mausu wa kakui to iemasu. demo koko de wa kare wa kakkoyoku arimasen,
native: Then you can say Mickey Mouse or kakui. But here's a he's not cool,

en: right? Then you can say Mickey Mouse or kakui, yokinai this.
zh: 對吧？然後你可以說米奇老鼠不帥，yokinai。
ja: そうですね？それからミッキーマウスはkakui yokinaiと言えます。
local: right? Then you can say Mickey Mouse or kakui, yokinai this.
ja_pron: sō desu ne? sorekara Mikkī Mausu wa kakui yokinai to iemasu.
native: right? Then you can say Mickey Mouse or kakui, yokinai this.

en: So it conjugates like e, good. Because kakui means style or how you dress and then e is good.
zh: 所以它像 e 一樣變化，因為 kakui 意味著風格或穿著方式，e 是好。
ja: だからeのように活用します。kakuiはスタイルや服装のことを意味し、eは良いという意味です。
local: So it conjugates like e, good. Because kakui means style or how you dress and then e is good.
ja_pron: dakara e no yō ni katsuyō shimasu. kakui wa sutairu ya fukusō no koto o imi shi, e wa yoi to iu imi desu.
native: So it conjugates like e, good. Because kakui means style or how you dress and then e is good.

en: So they get to look. And if you want to say oh he was cool, he was good looking.
zh: 所以他們看起來很棒。如果你想說他很酷，他很帥氣。
ja: だから彼らは見た目が良いのです。もし「彼はかっこよかった」と言いたいなら、
local: So they get to look. And if you want to say oh he was cool, he was good looking.
ja_pron: dakara karera wa mitame ga yoi no desu. moshi 'kare wa kakkoyokatta' to iitai nara,
native: So they get to look. And if you want to say oh he was cool, he was good looking.

en: Then you can say kakui yokata, kakui yokata.
zh: 你可以說 kakui yokata, kakui yokata。
ja: kakui yokata, kakui yokataと言えます。
local: Then you can say kakui yokata, kakui yokata.
ja_pron: kakui yokata, kakui yokata to iemasu.
native: Then you can say kakui yokata, kakui yokata.

en: And if you want to say he was not cool, then you can say kakui yokula kappa kakui yokinai kappa.
zh: 如果你想說他不酷，你可以說 kakui yokula kappa kakui yokinai kappa。
ja: もし彼がかっこよくなかったと言いたいなら、kakui yokula kappa kakui yokinai kappaと言えます。
local: And if you want to say he was not cool, then you can say kakui yokula kappa kakui yokinai kappa.
ja_pron: moshi kare ga kakkoyokunakatta to iitai nara, kakui yokula kappa kakui yokinai kappa to iemasu.
native: And if you want to say he was not cool, then you can say kakui yokula kappa kakui yokinai kappa.

en: So e and kakui please be careful, but they are the only irregulars so you don't have to be careful with other ones.
zh: 所以 e 和 kakui 請小心，但它們是唯一的不規則詞，其他的不用擔心。
ja: だからeとkakuiには注意してください。でもそれらだけが不規則で、他は気にしなくていいです。
local: So e and kakui please be careful, but they are the only irregulars so you don't have to be careful with other ones.
ja_pron: dakara e to kakui ni wa chūi shite kudasai. demo sorera dake ga fukisoku de, hoka wa ki ni shinakute ii desu.
native: So e and kakui please be careful, but they are the only irregulars so you don't have to be careful with other ones.

en: Today sounds like an irregular, but it's not an irregular. It just looks irregular, but it's actually large too.
zh: 今天聽起來像不規則，但它不是不規則。它只是看起來不規則，但其實也很常見。
ja: 今日という言葉は不規則に聞こえますが、不規則ではありません。見た目だけ不規則で、実はよく使われます。
local: Today sounds like an irregular, but it's not an irregular. It just looks irregular, but it's actually large too.
ja_pron: kyō to iu kotoba wa fukisoku ni kikoemasu ga, fukisoku de wa arimasen. mitame dake fukisoku de, jitsu wa yoku tsukawaremasu.
native: Today sounds like an irregular, but it's not an irregular. It just looks irregular, but it's actually large too.

en: So it's nothing to eat about it. Here ain't enough. Anyways, I hope you found this lesson news for as well.
zh: 所以沒什麼好說的。這裡不夠。無論如何，我希望你覺得這課有用。
ja: だから特に言うことはありません。ここは十分ではありません。とにかく、このレッスンが役に立ったことを願っています。
local: So it's nothing to eat about it. Here ain't enough. Anyways, I hope you found this lesson news for as well.
ja_pron: dakara toku ni iu koto wa arimasen. koko wa jūbun de wa arimasen. tonikaku, kono ressun ga yaku ni tatta koto o negatte imasu.
native: So it's nothing to eat about it. Here ain't enough. Anyways, I hope you found this lesson news for as well.

en: After this lesson, I'm going to teach you the book books and that I love teaching books. It's so much fun.
zh: 這課後，我會教你書本，我喜歡教書，真的很有趣。
ja: このレッスンの後、本を教えます。本を教えるのが大好きです。本当に楽しいです。
local: After this lesson, I'm going to teach you the book books and that I love teaching books. It's so much fun.
ja_pron: kono ressun no ato, hon o oshiemasu. hon o oshieru no ga daisuki desu. hontō ni tanoshii desu.
native: After this lesson, I'm going to teach you the book books and that I love teaching books. It's so much fun.

en: Knowing basics of auditives will help some books. So please view the ones we had.
zh: 了解聽力基礎會幫助學習一些書籍。請觀看我們之前的課程。
ja: 聴解の基本を知ることは本の学習に役立ちます。だから、以前のレッスンを見てください。
local: Knowing basics of auditives will help some books. So please view the ones we had.
ja_pron: chōkai no kihon o shiru koto wa hon no gakushū ni yakudachimasu. dakara, izen no ressun o mite kudasai.
native: Knowing basics of auditives will help some books. So please view the ones we had.

en: And if you have any questions please leave a comment down in the next one.
zh: 如果你有任何問題，請在下一個影片留言。
ja: もし質問があれば、次の動画でコメントを残してください。
local: And if you have any questions please leave a comment down in the next one.
ja_pron: moshi shitsumon ga areba, tsugi no dōga de komento o nokoshite kudasai.
native: And if you have any questions please leave a comment down in the next one.
